+root := `git rev-parse --show-toplevel`

+datasource := internal + "/datasource"

+resource := internal + "/resource"

+    mkdir -p {{root}}/test
+    mkdir -p {{root}}/docs
+    mkdir -p {{root}}/build
+    mkdir -p {{root}}/configs
+
+mkdocs:

+template target:
